summary: Social media app with premium home page, profile pages, and a friend system including friend requests, friend zone page, direct messaging (real-time polling-based chat), and sharing features (posts, content, links via chat).
architectural_notes: Platform does not support WebSockets; use fast polling for near-real-time messaging.
App runs on Internet Computer as a web application (not native Android/iOS); PWA install is possible but no Play Store publishing.
known_issues: Initial attempt to build full friend system + messaging in one pass failed with an AI error; rebuilding step by step.

existing_features.title: Add React Query hooks in useQueries.ts for all new friend system backend functions: useSendFriendRequest, useRespondToFriendRequest, useCancelFriendRequest, useUnfriend, useGetIncomingFriendRequests, useGetOutgoingFriendRequests, useGetFriendsList, useGetFriendshipStatus.

Update the UserProfilePage to show a dynamic friend request button based on friendship status. If not friends: show 'Add Friend' button. If request pending (outgoing): show 'Request Sent' (cancel option). If request pending (incoming): show 'Accept' and 'Decline' buttons. If already friends: show 'Friends' with an 'Unfriend' option in a dropdown.

new_feature_requests.summary: Friend system: send/accept/decline friend requests from profile pages or user search, friends list with unfriend option
Friend Zone Page: pending requests (incoming & outgoing), people you may know / user search, friends list
Direct Messaging (friends only): chat inbox, message threads with fast polling for near-instant updates, message history per conversation
Sharing: share posts, content, and links directly to a friend via chat; share profile links

Add a Friend data model to the backend with friend request states (Pending, Accepted, Declined). Store friend relationships as a list of FriendRequest records with sender, receiver, status, and timestamp fields.

Add backend functions: sendFriendRequest(receiver: Principal), respondToFriendRequest(sender: Principal, accept: Bool), cancelFriendRequest(receiver: Principal), unfriend(friendPrincipal: Principal), getIncomingFriendRequests(), getOutgoingFriendRequests(), getFriendsList(), and getFriendshipStatus(otherPrincipal: Principal).
